orientationAndFormula.coordinates: All integer coordinates use top-left origins. displayXY addresses the upright image; rawXY addresses stored PNG bytes. Samples are from original PNG pixels, not resized previews or JPEGs.
orientationAndFormula.landscape: Raw storage is 2064 x 2752 with EXIF 274=8. Upright display is 2752 x 2064. display(x,y) -> raw(2063-y,x); inverse raw(x,y) -> display(y,2063-x). Thus display(1953,56) -> raw(2007,1953). This is a coordinate mapping only; no rotated image was written.
orientationAndFormula.portrait: Raw/display 2064 x 2752, orientation absent or 1; identity mapping.
orientationAndFormula.profile: All five PNGs declare sRGB chunk 00, perceptual rendering intent. Their encoded RGB bytes are treated as sRGB; no ICC or physical-display calibration was applied.
orientationAndFormula.formula: For each 8-bit channel v, c=v/255; linear=c/12.92 if c<=0.04045, else ((c+0.055)/1.055)^2.4. Y=0.2126*Rlinear+0.7152*Glinear+0.0722*Blinear. Contrast=(max(Y1,Y2)+0.05)/(min(Y1,Y2)+0.05), rounded to 3 decimals.
orientationAndFormula.proxyLimit: Backdrop points are actual nearby composited scene/shadow pixels. They do not reconstruct the hidden background beneath an opaque multicolor glyph. Local ratios are not whole-glyph minima or whole-control pass/fail thresholds.

wholeScreenFindings: Selected Seed landscape 0/25/50 and portrait 0 preserve a continuous scene, complete score/objective and ordered forecast, native bottom actions, and dominant playable stars. The pause remains a small recognizable two-bar utility; no clipping or displaced controls were observed in these complete frames.

Across the three sampled bright landscape stages the pearl core is close to nearby stone, while the brass and dark contour retain separation. In portrait 0 the sampled body separates more strongly, while brass and dark-edge pairs are weaker against a differently colored nearby pixel. This is a robustness opportunity, not a demonstrated full-control recognition failure.

The Lantern selected-column-6 comparator has a different scene, state and Calm context. Its stronger sampled light-body separation is useful context, not a matched Seed before/after or a general dark-scene minimum.
The terminal 18-light landscape frames are result presentations with ceremony/actions. They are excluded from active-pause measurements and do not extend the claim to current authored Seed rules.
candidateBoundary: Compare a small contextual backing in the official shared utility owner for gameplay pause only. Preserve original glyph, native target, position and input semantics. Practice Close remains clear. Leave ordinary trail, painting, score/receipt anchors and unrelated controls unchanged on this evidence.
limits: Detailed pixel record covers four selected Seed screenshots and one existing dark comparator, not all 16 baseline images or the 105-source intersection survey.
Fully composited stills cannot establish alpha-isolated glyph bounds, every edge contrast, hidden-background color or a global minimum.
No active timing-head loss, continuous motion, actual VoiceOver, physical-device recognition/performance, minimum-iOS or whole-product acceptance is claimed.
The source-inferred 48-point pause target remains distinct from measured raster runs and from other tests that independently measure native target floors.
This baseline record does not accept any Goal3 candidate. A source-bound matched native comparison and whole-screen visual review are still required.
verificationPerformed: Read-only original PNG chunk decoding, integer RGB sampling, source/run inspection and this JSON only. No App/test edits, image edits or exports, builds, tests or simulator controllers.
